hero.subtitle: Online booking, a smart team calendar and a client CRM in one simple app — set up in minutes with AI. Your clients book from your own link, QR code or Zalo, and pay at your salon as usual.
hero.trialNote: 14-day trial with Pro features · no free plan after the trial

features.title: One app for bookings, team and clients

bookingPage.title: Your own online booking page
bookingPage.body: Share one link, a QR code at reception or your Zalo. Clients pick a service, a stylist and a time — 24/7.

calendar.title: Smart calendar for the whole team
calendar.body: Every stylist, room and break in one view. No double bookings — availability is checked for you.

crm.title: Client CRM
crm.body: Visit history, notes, favourite services and no-shows for every client, in one place.

aiSetup.title: Effortless AI setup
aiSetup.body: Upload screenshots of your price list and AI creates your services, prices and durations. Included in every plan.

insights.title: Insights
insights.body: Bookings, returning clients, busy hours and estimated revenue at a glance.

reminders.title: Reminders via Zalo and email
reminders.body: Automatic booking confirmations and reminders cut no-shows without extra work.

assistant.title: AI business assistant
assistant.body: Ask in plain language: “How many bookings this week?” “Who hasn’t come back in 3 months?”

pricing.title: Simple plans for every salon
pricing.trial: Every plan starts with a 14-day trial with Pro features and Basic limits (AI usage and message quotas). There is no free plan.

basic.name: Basic
basic.items:

marketplace.title: The GuGu marketplace
marketplace.body: Once GuGu establishes its Vietnamese company, partner salons will be listed in the GuGu marketplace free of charge, so new clients can discover and book you.
marketplace.offer: Every salon that subscribes before the marketplace launches pays no booking fees for its first 2 years after launch.
marketplace.point2: No booking fees for 2 years for early subscribers
marketplace.point3: Your own booking page works from day one
marketplace.disclaimer: The GuGu marketplace and the terms above will start only after GuGu’s Vietnamese company has been established, in accordance with Vietnamese law. Detailed terms may be published at that time.

faq.title: Questions salon owners ask
faq.a1: Yes. You get 14 days with Pro features and Basic limits. After the trial you choose Basic, Pro or Ultra — there is no free plan.
faq.q2: Do my clients need to install an app?
faq.a2: No. They book on your booking page from a link, QR code or your Zalo, in Vietnamese or English.
faq.a3: No. Clients pay at your salon as usual. GuGu handles bookings, your calendar and your client list.
faq.a4: Minutes. Upload screenshots of your price list and AI creates your services; add your team and opening hours and share your link.
faq.a5: After GuGu’s Vietnamese company is established, in line with Vietnamese law. Salons that subscribe before then get the early-subscriber terms described above.

footer.tagline: Salon software made in Vietnam. Bookings, team and clients in one app.
